events.name: Jim Henson's Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock Live!
events.info: Magic City Productions presents Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock LIVE! Get ready to dance your cares away! It's an all-new Fraggle Rock adventure with lots of songs and surprises. Young and young at heart will love seeing iconic Henson characters in an unforgettable live experience for the whole family! Jim Henson's Fraggle Rock is an award-winning, beloved hit family franchise full of music, comedy, joy, and iconic Henson puppets. Today's families are being introduced to the Fraggles via the acclaimed Emmy Award-winning series Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock, now streaming on Apple TV. The first-ever Fraggle Rock live show, Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock LIVE, features everyone's favorite Fraggles, Doozers and Gorgs on a brand-new exciting, interactive, live musical adventure that blends nostalgic fun with heartfelt Henson magic in a production that is perfect for Silly Creatures ofall ages!

Allowed Items: Small bags, purses, backpacks, totes (subject to search) Personal snacks (must be in clear 1 gallon ziplock bag) One 20 oz. sealed water bottle (1 per fan) Empty water bottles / camelbacks Blankets Portable phone chargers Personal point-and-shoot cameras Lighters Electronic cigarettes Small tote umbrellas Lawn/beach chairs (that are no more than 9 inches off the ground and the seatback does not exceed 24 inches off the ground) Prohibited Items Include (but are not limited to): Weapons of any kind Alcohol Illegal drugs/ substances of any kind Drug paraphernalia of any kind Lawn/beach chairs that are higher than 9 inches off the ground Glass containers Cans Laser pointers Animals (except service animals) Fireworks Wallet chains or spikes Professional cameras Video/audio recording equipment of any nature (including sports action cameras like GoPros) Balls of any nature Objects that can be used as projectiles such as glowsticks Larger banners or posters Promotional materials of any kind Coolers
generalInfo.childRule: Children 2 and under are free. The child must sit on your lap if you have reserved seating. For the Peach Music Festival, Children under 5 are free. Children between the ages of 5-10 can get a half price GA ticket when they arrive. If the parent purchased a VIP or reserved ticket, the child must also have a full price ticket. The half priced ticket is only for GA tickets and is only available at the door.
